Maintain the separation between the user and their online persona/actions.

Display a login message which describes the chatroom along with the usernames of the other people using that chatroom.

3.Surround with double parenthesis:  Used for out of character (ooc) chat. This describes what the actual person, not their character, is feeling or doing. For example: ((I'm taking my pants off in real life))
